item.title: Hull’s last remaining Scotch Derrick Crane returns home after restoration
item.description: Hull’s last remaining Scotch Derrick crane has been successfully restored and reinstated at the North End Shipyard, marking a major milestone in the city’s maritime heritage project. This iconic crane, a striking reminder of Hull’s rich shipbuilding history, has undergone extensive restoration thanks to funding from Hull City Council and The National Lottery Heritage Fund. […]

item.description: A historic part of Hull is subject to proposed changes as part of Hull City Council’s commitment to reviewing all 26 of the city’s conservation areas. item.title: Hull joins UNESCO’s Global Network of Learning Cities
item.description: Hull is celebrating after it was announced the city has joined UNESCO’s Global Network of Learning Cities.
